dct_title_s: Particulars of a valuable Sugar Estate : called "Point Mulatre," situate in the Parish of St. Patrick, in the Island of Dominica, and containing 603 acres, or thereabouts : which will be sold by auction, with the live and dead stock thereon, in one lot, by Messrs.
